name: @pipeworx/mcp-iconify

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search for icons by keyword across all collections. Returns icon names in prefix:name format (e.g., "mdi:home"). Use get_icons to fetch SVG data for results.

tools.name: get_icons
tools.description: Get SVG code and dimensions for specific icons. Input icon names in prefix:name format (e.g., "mdi:home", "fa:star"). Returns SVG markup, width, and height.

icons.description: Comma-separated icon names within the collection (e.g., "home,arrow-left,user")

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Browse available icon collections. Returns prefix, name, icon count, author, license, and category. Use the prefix with search_icons or get_icons.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-iconify forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the iconify pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
